title: Ja'far the Barmecide and the Bean-Seller
logline: A Bedouin poet who lost his generous patron is sent by a dream to a rich merchant in Basra with one strange password, a single bean, and learns how Ja'far once turned a shivering bean-seller's last bean into a fortune.
moral: A kindness is never lost: the one who received it carries it on long after the giver is gone.
tone: Warm and bittersweet with a comic middle: loss and quiet grief at the start, a mystery (why a bean?), a playful, escalating flashback of generosity, and a grateful, smiling ending. No violence is shown.

beats.summary: Every year the Bedouin recites a praise poem and Ja'far gives him a thousand dinars, a year's living for his family.
He returns to Baghdad and finds Ja'far executed: the window dark, the door chained.
People are afraid to mourn in public; a tear is wiped away in a hurry.
He weeps at the resting place and reads the undelivered poem, then sleeps.
Ja'far appears in a dream and sends him to a merchant in Basra.
The password: the sign of the bean. The mystery is planted.
At the name and the bean the rich merchant bursts into tears.
A thousand dinars and five hundred more of his own.
The Bedouin asks the question the audience is asking: why a bean?
The merchant was once a poor bean-seller in Baghdad's streets.
On a cold rainy day Ja'far sees him shivering under his window and calls him up.
The guests pay for each measure of beans with gold instead of coppers.
The lady buys half a bean for double all the gold collected.
Ja'far doubles the total again for his own half.
The seller trades in Basra and becomes a rich merchant.
He never forgot Ja'far's kindness; what he gives now is a drop from his wealth.

sets.description: Ja'far's reception hall (majlis): paper-coloured wall with blue Ben-Day dots, three pointed arches, one arched window with warm yellow light on the right, a hanging lamp, a low red dais with cushions, yellow tiled floor (as houseRoom's floor). Options: {light: 0..1, curtain: 0..1, variant}.

The Basra merchant's room: palaceHall drawn with variant 'merchant' (two arches, an arched door on the left, shelves with bolts of cloth and jars, a low desk with coin stacks, a back-wall window for the sun and moon day counter, a curtain on the right hiding the treasure). Not a separate drawing.

A Baghdad street: skyline of flat roofs and two domes behind (like nightCity's skyline in day colours), two house fronts with shutters on the left, a palace facade on the right with a door (open 0..1, or chained and planked) and a balcony window (lit or dark). Options: {palette: 'dusk'|'cold'|'clear', rain: 0..1, palace: 'lit'|'shut', shutters: 0..1}.

Library nightCity (moon, stars, skyline) with a ground strip at y 900 and the graveMarker prop; for the dream a blue halftone wash and vignette; for the waking, a crossfade of the sky to the 'dawn' preset.

The road to Basra: Library sky (day) and sun, three parallax dune bands (flat yellow and sand with red dot shade), a ground strip, palms and low houses of Basra at the far right, a quay line. Option {town: 0..1}.

props.description: The praise poem: a paper roll with red end knobs; open 0..1 unrolls a strip with wavy black lines.
A fat round leather purse with a drawstring and a yellow coin peeking out; scale option for the small +500 purse.
A broad bean: yellow-green kidney shape, black outline, red dot shade, a dark eye mark; options s, glow 0..1, split 0..1, half 'L'|'R' (flat pale face).

A round woven basket (سلة) carrying a lidded clay bean pot and a ladle; options lid 0..1, steam 0..1, level 0..1 (beans), gold 0..1 (coins to the brim). The seller's tin bowl (إناء) is a small separate dish drawn by the same function.

Gold coins: single discs (gold or small copper) and a heap built from n seeded discs with glints; used for the bowl, the doubling heaps and the treasure. Includes chest and sack shapes for the big heap.
A plain upright stone on a low mound with a folded blue vizier turban cloth laid on it. No body, no gallows.

scenes.summary: The yearly ritual in Ja'far's hall: the Bedouin poet arrives with a scroll, recites, and Ja'far rewards him with a purse of a thousand dinars that feeds his family for a year.

camera.notes: Open wide on the hall (zoom 1.0, centre 500,640), hold to 2.3; ease in to a two-shot (twoShot(bedouin, jaafar, {margin: 90}), zoom about 1.45) by 5.2; hold. Small drift up 30 units at 12.7 to make room for the family thought cloud above the Bedouin.

scenes.composition: Ja'far seated on a low dais at x 700 facing left, head at y 640; the Bedouin enters from the left edge and stops at x 330. Arched window with warm yellow light behind Ja'far; a hanging lamp top centre. Year counter top left of the panel; dinar counter top right. Thought cloud at 12.7 sits above the Bedouin (x 120..520, y 250..520), never over a face.

actions.action: Dinar counter top right spins 0 to 1000 and locks on the word 'dinar'.

scenes.summary: One year he returns to Baghdad with a new poem and finds the palace shut and dark: Ja'far has been executed, and people are afraid to grieve in the open.

camera.notes: Track right with the walking Bedouin (zoom 1.25) until he stops at 19.7; cut-free tilt up to the dark palace window at 20.6; push in to his face (zoom 1.9) at 21.8; pull out to a wide (zoom 1.15) at 23.0 to show the townsfolk hurrying past.

The Bedouin walks left to right and stops at x 430 below and left of the window so his eye line runs up-right to it. Townsfolk cross in the foreground at y 930, slightly larger, heads below his face.

scenes.summary: The dream: Ja'far appears in blue light and gives three instructions: go to Basra, find a well-known merchant, ask for a thousand dinars, and mention the sign of the bean. The Bedouin wakes at dawn.

Dream Ja'far floats at x 720, feet at y 760 (no legs below the hem: the robe ends in a comic wisp). The dream map appears in the open sky upper left (x 90..560, y 150..470).

actions.acting: PERSON_HANDS.cupMouth, talk 1 on the call, chest lifts; hopeful brows -0.4.

actions.action: He lifts the pot lid: steam curls and three plump beans bob up over the rim; label HOT BEANS with an arrow.
actions.acting: Steam is the only warm thing in the grey street (yellow dots).
actions.library: beanBasket {lid:0..1, steam:1}; bean prop; S.label + S.arrow

actions.action: Walks past without looking; the seller offers a ladle after him and lowers it.
actions.acting: Passer: gaze straight ahead, fast. Seller: gaze follows him out, arm sinks with follow-through.

actions.action: A second passer-by shakes her head and hurries on, wrapped in a thick cloak. Label BAGHDAD, as in S2, top left.
actions.acting: She is warm, he is not: contrast in the costumes. His smile holds one beat then drops.

actions.action: Counts the day's takings in his palm: two tiny copper coins.
actions.acting: Gaze down at the palm, brow -0.6, a sigh (sq 0.96 then back).
actions.library: person {costume:'beanSeller'} handR palm up; copper coin small

actions.action: A gust: his thin shirt flaps, a patch peels and flutters; he clamps it down with an elbow.
actions.acting: tip -0.06 against the wind, lid 0.5; cloth flap as two triangle keys.
actions.library: wind streak lines; shirt hem keys; swing

actions.action: Hugs himself over the warm pot and shivers; breath puffs out as small white clouds.
actions.acting: tremble(t, 3), PERSON_HANDS.folded, teeth-chatter mouth (talk flicker 0.2), wet nose-tip red dot.

scenes.summary: A cold rainy day: the seller passes under Ja'far's window; the vizier notices him shivering and calls him up to his hall.

camera.notes: Wide on the street in rain (zoom 1.15) with the lit palace window in the upper right; track with the seller to 107.0; tilt up to Ja'far in the window (zoom 1.7) at 107.9; a high over-shoulder from the window looking down at the tiny seller at 108.8 to 110.7; tilt back down to a medium on the seller for the 'ME?' beat; follow him to the door.

scenes.composition: marketStreet with rain on, palace facade right: the balcony window at x 720, y 330 glows warm yellow (the same window that was black in S2), the door below at x 720 now open a crack. The seller walks left to right at y 900 from x 60 to x 520, directly under the window by 107. Strong diagonal: Ja'far's gaze runs down-left, the seller's up-right.

actions.action: The sky darkens to slate; clouds slide in; first fat drops hit the street and the pot lid.
actions.acting: Each drop makes a tiny ring (ripple); the seller looks up and winces.

actions.action: Pulls his frayed cap down and hunches over the basket to keep the beans dry.
actions.acting: tip 0.12, lid 0.5, tremble(t, 2); breath puffs.

actions.action: Full rain: slanted seeded streaks across the panel, splashes on the ground, a puddle grows.
actions.acting: Rain streaks from K.rng so every frame is a pure function of t; streaks stay thin so faces remain clear.

actions.action: Trudges right through the puddles, each step a splash.
actions.acting: Short cold steps, shoulders up, gaze on the ground.

actions.action: He passes under the glowing balcony window; its warm light falls on him as a yellow patch on the wet street.
actions.acting: Arrow and label JA'FAR'S WINDOW; the seller does not look up yet.

actions.action: Ja'far comes to the window, a cup in his hand, looking out at the rain.
actions.acting: Relaxed, lid 0.3, then his gaze drops to the street.
actions.library: person {costume:'vizier'} at window (clipped at the sill); lookAt

actions.action: He notices: the cup stops halfway to his lips; he leans out over the sill.
actions.acting: Gaze locks on the seller (lookAt), brow -0.5 concern, tip 0.12 forward; noBlink 0.7 s.

actions.action: Seen from above, small in the rain: he shivers hard, the pot lid rattling.
actions.acting: tremble(t, 4), teeth-chatter mouth, two shiver lines each side; label SHIVERING with an arrow.

actions.action: Beckons with a big come-up-here wave.
actions.acting: PERSON_HANDS.wave turned into a beckon (hand scoops twice), warm smile, talk 0.6.

actions.action: Looks up at last, looks behind him, points at his own chest.
actions.acting: Eyes wide, gaze up-right then a saccade over his shoulder and back; PERSON_HANDS.chest; mouth 'o'.

actions.action: The palace door swings open, spilling warm light; he hurries in, leaving wet footprints.
actions.acting: anticipate() then a quick walk, basket hugged; the door light widens as a yellow wedge.

scenes.summary: In the hall Ja'far orders his guests to buy the beans; each one who takes a measure fills the seller's bowl with gold pieces instead of small change.

camera.notes: Wide on the hall (zoom 1.05): the same framing as S1's opening. Push to a medium on the seller and the queue (zoom 1.6) from 118.2; insert on the bowl (zoom 2.2) at 121.7 to 123.5; back to the medium for his reaction.

scenes.composition: palaceHall as in S1, warm. Ja'far on the dais at x 760 facing left. The dripping seller stands at x 300 facing right, basket on the floor before him at x 380, his empty tin bowl beside it at x 450. Three courtiers on cushions between (x 520, 590, 660), who get up and queue from the right. A puddle forms round the seller's feet.

actions.action: Stands and sweeps an arm across his guests toward the bean basket: an order.
actions.acting: PERSON_HANDS.pointFwd with a big anticipation, brow 0.3 mock-stern, talk 0.8; then a hidden smile.

actions.action: The three guests look at each other, then at the wet little man.
actions.acting: Staggered head turns (stagger(i)); each a different reaction: amused, puzzled, already reaching for his purse.

actions.action: Stands dripping and frightened, clutching his ladle; a drop falls from his cap brim.
actions.acting: tremble(t, 1.5) fading as the room warms him; gaze darting between the lords (saccades); sq 0.95 small.

actions.action: Ja'far points; the pot lid lifts, steam and beans show; label BUY HIS BEANS.
actions.acting: Steam drifts toward the guests; courtier 3 sniffs and smiles.

actions.action: The first guest gets up and steps to the basket; the others rise behind him one at a time, forming a queue.
actions.acting: Never in unison: stagger 0.25 s; walk with footfalls.

actions.action: Ladles one measure of beans into the guest's cupped hands.
actions.acting: Careful, professional even now: gaze on the ladle; then holds out his palm for a copper.
actions.library: person {costume:'beanSeller'} handR ladle arc; bean prop x5

actions.action: Instead of a copper the guest pours a stream of gold coins into the seller's tin bowl until it brims.
actions.acting: Coins as yellow discs on fallY with tiny bounces; the bowl rings (struck-object squash 8 percent).
actions.library: coin prop gold; fallY + rebound; bowl squash

actions.action: Stares into the bowl: his jaw drops and the ladle hangs forgotten.
actions.acting: Eyes wide, mouth 'o', sq 1.06 stretch up then settle; slow look up at the guest, then at Ja'far.

actions.action: Label GOLD! with an arrow to the bowl; a glint star on the heap.
actions.acting: On 'al-dhahab' (123.6).

actions.action: A small copper coin appears beside the bowl with a red X through it.
actions.acting: Reads as: not small change.

actions.action: Guests two and three take their measures in quick succession: ladle, pour, ladle, pour. The gold now heaps over the rim; a gold counter (bar meter, no figure) climbs at the top right.
actions.acting: Each faster than the last; Ja'far watches from the dais with folded arms and a pleased half-lidded smile.
actions.library: stagger; coin fallY; S.counter as a meter; PERSON_HANDS.folded

scenes.summary: The beans run out until a single bean is left in the basket. Ja'far splits it in two and gives one half to a lady of his household.

camera.notes: Top-angled insert into the basket (zoom 2.3) as the bean count falls; hold on the last bean 132.5 to 134.2; cut out to a medium three-shot (zoom 1.5) for the splitting; small push on the two halves at 135.7.

scenes.composition: Insert: the basket's pot fills the panel centre, beans as yellow-green ovals. Then medium: seller left at x 300, Ja'far has come down from the dais to x 520 (centre), the lady enters from the right to x 720. The two bean halves are held at head height in the open space between Ja'far and the lady so they read against the plain wall.

actions.action: Ladle after ladle dips in: the bean level in the pot sinks in four steps.
actions.acting: Bean counter top left runs down fast: MANY, 12, 5, 2.

actions.action: Scrapes the ladle round the pot: a hollow scrape, nothing.
actions.acting: Worried brow -0.6 (nothing left to sell), gaze into the pot.

actions.action: Tips the pot toward us to show it is empty: one bean rattles round the bottom.
actions.acting: The bean rolls on a damped swing and comes to rest in the centre.

actions.action: Everything else in the frame dims; the basket rim frames the single bean like a spotlight.
actions.acting: Stillness: nothing moves but a slow glow.

actions.action: Arrow and label ONE BEAN LEFT; the bean counter clicks to 1.
actions.acting: The same glowing bean as in the dream (S4): the audience connects them.

actions.action: Ja'far's hand comes into the insert and lifts the bean out between finger and thumb.
actions.acting: Delicate, slow; the seller's eyes follow it up (lookAt).

actions.action: Medium shot: he holds the bean up to the light, sets both thumbs on it and snaps it in two.
actions.acting: anticipate() 0.3 s (elbows out), then a quick snap with a 2-frame white flash; delighted eyes, tongue-tip concentration before.
actions.library: person {costume:'vizier'} both hands to a point; bean {split:0..1}

actions.action: The two halves separate, one in each hand, flat faces toward us; labels 1/2 and 1/2.
actions.acting: Overshoot apart and settle; the seller and the courtiers (heads at the frame edge) lean in.

actions.action: A lady of the household glides in from the right, curious.
actions.acting: Smooth walk, veil trailing 2 frames behind, gaze on the half bean; amused brows.

actions.action: Offers her one half on his open palm with a small bow.
actions.acting: tip 0.08, playful smile, gaze to her then a side glance at the seller (he is up to something).

actions.action: She takes the half bean, examines it like a jewel, and smiles.
actions.acting: Holds it at eye level, lid 0.3, mouth smile; label LADY OF THE HOUSE with an arrow.

scenes.summary: The lady buys her half of the bean for twice all the gold collected; then Ja'far pays twice the total again for his own half.

camera.notes: Medium three-shot (zoom 1.5); pull out and tilt up in two steps (140.8 and 146.0) as the gold pile grows, ending wide (zoom 1.05) with the pile towering; final small push on the seller's eyes peeking over the gold at 149.0.

scenes.composition: The seller at x 300 with his brimming bowl at his feet (x 400). The lady at x 720, Ja'far at x 560. The gold accumulates as a pile between the seller and the others at x 400 to 480: first the bowl, then a heap twice its size, then a heap that reaches above the seller's head, so by the end he has to look over or round it.

actions.action: Claps her hands twice; a servant's arms (only arms, from the right edge) bring a small chest.
actions.acting: Brisk, amused; gaze flicks to Ja'far: watch this.
actions.library: person {costume:'lady'} clap; arms-only person crop; chest prop

actions.action: Tips the chest: gold pours out beside the seller's bowl.
actions.acting: anticipate() heave; coins on fallY with bounces.

actions.action: Balloon above her: half bean, an equals sign, and the gold heap.
actions.acting: Clear picture sum, no numbers; placed over the wall, not over a face.

actions.action: The new heap grows until it is exactly two bowls high next to the bowl; bracket and label x2.
actions.acting: The x2 stamps on 'bi-di'f' with a pop; heap overshoots and settles.

actions.action: Looks from his bowl to the heap, back and forth; his knees start to fold.
actions.acting: Saccades, mouth 'o', sq 0.92 sinking; hands rise slowly to his cheeks (PERSON_HANDS.cheeks).

actions.action: Ja'far holds up his own half bean, taps his chest, and snaps his fingers.
actions.acting: Competitive twinkle: brow raise, wink 'R' to the lady; she laughs behind her hand (PERSON_HANDS.mouthCover).

actions.action: Two big sacks are set down from the right edge; he slits one with a finger and gold floods out.
actions.acting: Big anticipation, then follow-through as the flood pushes coins across the floor.

actions.action: Balloon above Ja'far: his half bean equals the whole pile so far, doubled.
actions.acting: Same picture grammar as the lady's balloon.

actions.action: The pile doubles again and rises past the seller's head; second label x2 stamps; camera has pulled wide to hold it.
actions.acting: Pile wobbles like jelly once on the stamp (sq 0.96, 1.03, 1).

actions.action: Only his cap and two round eyes show over the gold; he looks to camera once, then slides down out of sight in a faint.
actions.acting: The one deliberate lens stare of the film: gaze [0, 0.05], noBlink; then lid flutter and drop.
actions.library: person {costume:'beanSeller'} gaze to camera; fallY small

scenes.summary: The bean-seller walks out of the palace with a fortune in his basket that he never dreamed of.

camera.notes: Medium on the palace door (zoom 1.5) as he backs out; track left with him; push on the basket (zoom 2.0) at 154.8; back out for the pinch.

scenes.composition: marketStreet, same facade as S9 but the rain has stopped: a sun breaks through upper left, puddles shine. He comes out of the door at x 720 and walks left (toward where he came from) to x 380. The basket now brims with gold, the bean pot perched empty on top.

actions.action: Backs out of the palace door bowing again and again, dragging the heavy basket.
actions.acting: tip 0.2 bows, each smaller; strain: sq 0.94, the basket scrapes two lines on the wet ground.

actions.action: Turns round and heaves the basket up in both arms; staggers three steps under the weight.
actions.acting: anticipate() squat, lift with stretch, then a wide-legged heavy walk; cheeks puffed (mouth closed, brow 0.4).
actions.library: anticipate; walk heavy + footfalls + ripple splashes

actions.action: Label HIS BASKET with an arrow: gold to the brim, the empty bean pot on top.
actions.acting: A coin slips off; he catches it with his foot and flicks it back in.

actions.action: The clouds part: a sunbeam hits the basket and it flashes with glint stars; label A FORTUNE!
actions.acting: On 'tharwa'; the puddles reflect yellow.

actions.action: Stops, sets the basket down, and pinches his own arm. It hurts. It is real.
actions.acting: Eyes shut tight for the pinch (lid 1), a small jump (hop), then eyes open wide and a huge smile.
actions.library: person {costume:'beanSeller'} handR to arm; hop + landSquash

actions.action: Looks back up at the lit window and puts his hand on his heart; in the window Ja'far's small figure raises a hand.
actions.acting: wet happy eyes, PERSON_HANDS.chest; this image returns in the last scene.
actions.library: person {costume:'beanSeller'} PERSON_HANDS.chest; vizier at window small

scenes.summary: He goes to Basra and trades with the money until he becomes a rich merchant: one continuous walk in which the ragged seller turns, step by step, into the merchant we know.

camera.notes: Side-on tracking shot like S5 (zoom 1.2), same direction, so the two journeys rhyme; ease to a stop and push in (zoom 1.7) on the finished merchant at 163.1.

scenes.composition: desertRoad then the Basra edge of the set (palms, low houses, a quay line). He walks left to right at y 900. Behind him market goods pop up in sequence along the road (bolts of cloth, jars, a small boat on the quay), each bigger than the last. The costume changes happen behind passing foreground palms (three trunks at x 300, 520, 740 in world space, drawn over him) so each change is hidden by a wipe.

actions.action: Walks right along the road with the gold basket on his shoulder, still in rags.
actions.acting: Light step now, chin up, humming; dust puffs.

actions.action: Signpost BASRA slides in, the same post as in S5.
actions.acting: Rocks once (swing).

actions.action: Passes behind palm 1: comes out in a clean plain robe, a bolt of cloth under his arm; a stall with cloth pops up behind.
actions.acting: He trades a coin for the cloth with a quick hand-over to an arms-only seller; purposeful gaze.
actions.library: fgWipe by palm trunk; person costume blend 'beanSeller' to 'trader'; stall prop

actions.action: Passes behind palm 2: comes out with a neat small turban and a helper's arms carrying jars behind him; coins fly in an arc from the stall back into his purse (profit). Arrow up with label TRADE.
actions.acting: The arc of coins is bigger than what he paid.
actions.library: fgWipe; coin arcs (hop path); S.arrow + S.label

actions.action: Passes behind palm 3: a little boat at the quay loads boxes; a rising bar meter of gold climbs beside him.
actions.acting: Each step up of the meter lands on a footfall.
actions.library: boat as flat hull + sail triangle; S.counter meter; footfalls

actions.action: Comes out from the last palm as the merchant: big red turban, rich robe, round belly, the same moustache. He stops, hands on hips. Label RICH MERCHANT.
actions.acting: landSquash on the stop, proud PERSON_HANDS.hipsHands, then the proud look softens.

actions.action: He glances back the way he came (toward Baghdad, left) and touches his heart.
actions.acting: Gaze left and far, lid 0.3, PERSON_HANDS.chest: he has not forgotten. Sets up the last scene.

scenes.summary: Back in the present the merchant tells the Bedouin he never forgot Ja'far's kindness, and that the sum he gives now hardly dents his wealth. THE END.

camera.notes: Match-cut on the merchant's hand-on-heart pose into the present two-shot (zoom 1.6); drift up to the memory cloud at 167.3; at 172.2 pull out wide (zoom 1.05) to reveal the treasure behind the curtain; hold wide for THE END.

scenes.composition: merchantHouse as in S7: the Bedouin at x 340, the merchant at x 640, the two purses on the floor between them at x 480. A curtain covers the back wall right of the window (x 620..960). Memory cloud in the upper left (x 90..520, y 180..470). THE END title sits in the upper third over the plain wall, clear of both faces.

actions.action: The same hand-on-heart pose, now old again in his own house; he turns to the Bedouin.
actions.acting: Match-cut hold 6 frames, then gaze returns from far away to his guest; talk 0.6.

actions.action: Has been listening open-mouthed; closes his mouth and nods slowly. The bean question mark above him turns into an exclamation mark.
actions.acting: Understanding: brow relaxes, a slow blink, small smile.

actions.action: Shakes his head firmly: never.
actions.acting: Head shake as two small x offsets, eyes shut on the shake, then open and wet.

actions.action: Memory cloud: the lit palace window in the rain with Ja'far beckoning, and the glowing bean beside it.
actions.acting: Both men look up at it (lookAt); the Bedouin puts his hand on his heart too: two men who owe the same man.
actions.library: cloud(... inside): vizier at window + bean {glow:1}; lookAt

actions.action: Label inside the cloud: JA'FAR'S KINDNESS.
actions.acting: Small, under the window, clear of faces.

actions.action: Points down at the two purses on the floor.
actions.acting: PERSON_HANDS.pointDown, light dismissive smile; the Bedouin's gaze follows to the purses.

actions.action: Picks the purses up and presses them into the Bedouin's arms again; the 1500 counter shows once more.
actions.acting: Firm, kind; the Bedouin dips under the weight for the third time (running gag), smiling now.

actions.action: With his free hand he pulls the curtain cord: the curtain sweeps open on a mountain of chests, sacks and gold that fills the back of the room.
actions.acting: anticipate() tug; camera pulls out; the two purses look tiny against it. An arrow from the purses to the heap with the label A DROP!
actions.library: curtain open 0..1; coinPile large + chest + sack props; S.arrow + S.label

actions.action: Looks from the purses to the mountain and back; his keffiyeh tails lift with the double take.
actions.acting: Saccades, eyes wide, then a helpless laugh (talk 0.5, sq 1.03 bounces).

actions.action: Laughs with him and claps him on the shoulder.
actions.acting: Big smile, lid 0.5, handR to the Bedouin's shoulder; the Bedouin rocks with the clap (swing).

actions.action: After the last word: he pulls out the scroll, unrolls it with the S1 flourish and recites upward to the memory cloud; hearts rise; the merchant listens, hand on heart. THE END letters in over the wall and holds.
actions.acting: The poem finally delivered: the S1 sweep at full size, eyes wet and happy; in the cloud Ja'far's small figure raises a hand. Gentle breathe() on both through the hold.
actions.library: person {costume:'bedouin'} hold:'scroll', talk; heart(); S.title 'THE END'; breathe

ending.description: After the last word (175.26) the Bedouin unrolls his scroll and at last recites his poem for Ja'far, up to the memory cloud where Ja'far's small figure raises a hand; the merchant listens with his hand on his heart beside the opened treasure curtain. THE END letters in at 175.9 over the plain wall, clear of faces, and holds to 178.4 with gentle breathing and rising hearts.

new_assets.name: person costume presets (bedouin, vizier, merchant, beanSeller, lady, trader)
new_assets.description: A costume layer for the Library person figure so that human stories share one body, face, arm IK and gesture set. Each preset sets headwear (keffiyeh+agal, tall turban with jewel, big turban, frayed cap, veil, small turban), beard or moustache, robe length and colours, sash, belly width, and palette (pal 0..3, 'dream').
new_assets.implementation: Add an optional P.costume to person (default undefined = today's drawing, so the regression test stays identical). Draw the robe as a tapered rounded rect from shoulders to ankles over the existing legs (legs still animate under the hem with walk()), headwear as stacked ellipses or a draped polygon with two tail quads that take a lag offset, beards as a filled arc under the mouth. Keep head, eyes, mouth, brows, arms and PERSON_HANDS unchanged. Build first in the story file as personC(ctx, P) wrapping person, then move to Library/cast once approved.

new_assets.name: person kneel / sit
new_assets.description: kneel 0..1 and sit 0..1 for robed figures (the Bedouin at the stone, guests on cushions, the Bedouin as a guest).
new_assets.implementation: With a robe the legs are hidden: lower the torso by kneel*70 units, widen the hem into a rounded trapezoid resting on the ground; no leg drawing needed. Use landSquash on arrival.

new_assets.name: palaceHall (variant merchantHouse)
new_assets.description: Arched interior with window light, dais, lamp, tiled floor; the merchant variant adds door, shelves, desk and treasure curtain.
new_assets.implementation: Bake once with bake(): wall rect + S dots, arches as rect + half-ellipse cut-outs outlined with the brush, floor tiles as in houseRoom, window as an arch filled yellow with a light quad. Curtain and door are drawn live (open 0..1) as scaled quads with fold lines.

new_assets.name: marketStreet
new_assets.description: City street with skyline, shuttered house fronts and a palace facade with door and balcony window; palettes dusk, cold, clear; rain option.
new_assets.implementation: Skyline: rects and two half-circle domes in flat colour. Facades: rects with arch door and window cut-outs. Bake one layer per palette; window light, door state, shutters and the chain and planks are live overlays.

new_assets.name: desertRoad
new_assets.description: Dunes, palms and the edge of Basra for the two journeys.
new_assets.implementation: sky() + sun() + three sine-arc dune bands with parallax offsets from the camera x + ground(); palm = curved trunk quad with five leaf arcs; houses as flat rects.

new_assets.name: bean, beanBasket, purse, scroll, coinPile, graveMarker
new_assets.implementation: Each a single function of (ctx, x, y, opts) from ellipses, rounded rects and brush outlines. The bean split is two half shapes translated apart by split*40 with a pale flat face. coinPile places n discs on a seeded triangular heap (K.rng with a fixed seed) so it is identical every frame; growth is by drawing the first n.

new_assets.name: rain
new_assets.description: Slanted rain streaks with ground splashes and puddle rings.
new_assets.implementation: rain(ctx, t, {amount, seed}): for i < N, x and phase from K.rng(seed + i); y = ((t * speed + phase) mod 1) * height; a short slanted line each, clipped to the panel; splashes use Library ripple at seeded ground points with the same phase. Pure function of t.

new_assets.name: dream wash
new_assets.description: Blue halftone overlay and dotted vignette marking the dream; reusable for visions.
new_assets.implementation: A full-panel blue rect at alpha 0.35 with multiply-style flat tint, plus the style's dot primitive in a radial mask; fade with K.beat.

new_assets.name: costume change behind a foreground wipe
new_assets.description: The walker passes behind a foreground palm trunk and comes out in the next costume (seller to trader to merchant).
new_assets.implementation: Draw the actor, then the trunk over him; switch the costume preset at the instant his x equals the trunk x (he is fully covered if the trunk is wider than the figure: make the trunks 130 units wide at this scale, or add a leaf mass).

implementation_notes: Timing: use timing.json word starts (w(p, n)) for every cue listed here; the cue times in this plan are the word starts on the final MP3. Paragraph 8 was removed from the audio by design; the script has paragraphs 1 to 7 only and nothing may be added.
Set LIFE.t = t every frame so all figures blink; add explicit blinks where a lid is set by hand. Every figure always has a gaze target (lookAt or gazePlan); listeners look at the speaker.

Identity of the merchant across ages is the heart of the reveal: keep the same moustache shape and the red headwear in S6, S7, S8 to S14 and S15, and make the S7 to S8 match-cut on the eyes at the same panel position and zoom.

Three deliberate echoes must be staged identically: (1) the purse hand-over dip (S1 9.02, S7 71.48, S15 170.74); (2) the 1000 counter (S1, S4, S7); (3) the lit window (S1 warm hall, S2 dark, S9 lit, S13 and S15 in memory).
The glowing bean of the dream (50.12) and the last bean in the basket (132.5) use the same drawing, scale feel and glow.
Gold amounts in S10 to S12 are shown as heap sizes, a bar meter and x2 stamps only; the script gives no figures there, so do not print numbers.

Sound: effects only in the real gaps: 7.4 chime, 10.6 coin clink, 15.4 whoosh, 19.3 low thud, 51.55 chime, 58.5 whoosh, 164.9 whoosh, 175.6 chime, all via SND with master 0.6. Lettering such as CLINK! and SNAP! is visual only (no sound, the narrator is speaking).
Panel-only shake is not needed in this film; keep the camera calm. Use the template's camAt clamp; all faces and key props stay inside the panel (x 54..1026, y 54..1250).
Lettering diet: about 14 comic words in the film plus labels; never over a face; headlines at least 44 px and labels at least 28 px at 1280x720 scale; no en or em dashes.
Group rule in S10: the three courtiers never move together; use stagger(i) and three different reactions.

New drawings are built in the story's src first (personC, sets, props) and moved to Library after approval; nothing in Library changes its default look; run node Library/tests/regression.mjs after any Library edit.
warnings: Sensitive content: Ja'far's execution (21.84) and 'the place of his body' (30.0) are shown only as a dark, chained palace and a plain stone with his turban cloth; no body, weapon or gallows. Confirm this softening is acceptable.
Scope: the person costume system is the one large new asset (effort L) and six characters depend on it; build and approve it on a contact sheet before staging.

The script calls the container both a basket (السلة, سلته) and a vessel (إناء). The plan uses a basket holding the bean pot, plus a small tin bowl that receives the gold in S10; from S13 the gold is in the basket as the script says.
S4 runs 17.4 s and S7 19.4 s in one set each; both have a change at least every 1.5 s, but review them first for pace.
The word 'فضل' (about 168.50) was not recognised and its time is interpolated; the memory cloud is cued to 'ينس' (167.64) and the label to 'جعفر' (168.50) instead.
English lettering 'x2' uses a plain letter x; check it reads in Bangers.
Few real pauses exist in this narration (seven gaps of 0.3 s or more), so the film is almost without sound effects by necessity.
